given: Proxy's Recall bot is dropped from the meeting for 45 seconds by a transient network fault.
when: The bot drops and the transport attempts recovery.
then: It auto-rejoins exactly once and, on rejoin, announces the real [dropped, rejoined] interval plainly (the chat copy byte-equal to the spoken line, never padded/shrunk/presented as continuous); a second drop yields an honest terminal stop, not an infinite rejoin loop.
